learning_outcomes.description: Carry out surface cleaning

performance_criteria.description: Identify various surface types to determine appropriate cleaning methods.
Select suitable Cleaning Agents based on surface materials, ensuring compatibility and effectiveness
Identify any defects or irregularities that may impact floor covering installation.
Carry out various cleaning techniques, such as sweeping, vacuuming, and wiping, to achieve a clean and debris-free surface.

Identify unexpected issues or challenges during the surface cleaning process, implementing solutions to ensure optimal preparation.
Ensure that the cleaned surfaces meet quality standards, providing a suitable foundation for the installation of floor coverings.
